DMK approaches Supreme Court over Cauvery water release

The Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) party has filed a petition in the Supreme Court of India seeking immediate directions for the release of Cauvery river water to Tamil Nadu. The petition specifically requests that Karnataka be directed to release the water. This legal action addresses the ongoing dispute over water sharing between the two southern states.
